description: A request to run one capability.

call_id.description: Caller-chosen correlation id, echoed back in the result.

capability.description: Capability identifier, conventionally the node type.

input.description: The input the capability would receive.

node_type.description: Node type that would be executed.

reason.description: Why the caller wants it. Surfaced verbatim in approval prompts.

requested_permissions.description: Permissions the caller expects to need.

run_id.description: Run the call belongs to, when it is part of a workflow run.

title: ToolCall
